    int C[N][N] = {0};

    int sum[N] = {0};

    auto mul = [&](int a, int b) {

    };

    auto get = [&](int i) {
        return i * (i + 1) / 2;
    };

        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            C[i][j] = add(C[i - 1][j - 1], C[i - 1][j]);
        }
    }

    way[0] = 1;

        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {

        }
    }

    n += 1;
    f[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; j + k <= m && i + k + 1 <= n; ++k) {
                f[i + k + 1][j + k] = add(f[i + k + 1][j + k], mul(mul(f[i][j], way[k]), C[j + k][j]));

    cout << g[n][m] << "\n";
    return 0;
}
